headline: Haaland's backup dancers - The Best of the Best for your other two FWDs
body: We're back. For everyone who has joined the app / website, thank you! Please, please, use the feedback button for anything you want to change, fix, have thoughts on, anything. 🙏 I'm building this based on what I want, but I also want to build based on what you want, so please let me know. TLDR at the top: Isak and Barry. You're welcome. Nerd data behind the TLDR below: Anyway, let's dive right into it, xPts performed (per 90 basis, 15 min per match played) for forwards: https://preview.redd.it/mf1zy6na82xh1.png?width=1918&format=png&auto=webp&s=4a715ae9cfa856b117f53ac76d4971ae6764121f Wait, what is that I see? Nmecha? Flemming? Akpom? Mateta? Turns out forwards are RIFE with impact subs who show up and do their damndest to score a goal, who'd a thunk it: https://preview.redd.it/534gnrdt82xh1.png?width=3372&format=png&auto=webp&s=4b34bce77784322bfb5a4164caa76a45ce28d0c7 So this means we have to really increase the min mins played per match. Let's try 45: https://preview.redd.it/cxkkt1k092xh1.png?width=1918&format=png&auto=webp&s=c20b05c77a8c3cfc813320490741484ced458c8b Well, well, well. Mateta has sticking power, like a Gecko with great xGI and poor shot conversion: https://preview.redd.it/5snm6d3892xh1.png?width=3372&format=png&auto=webp&s=fbf966fbea84763b074c89e2783c939c5523851d Anyway, ignoring Mateta for now, here is the xPts performed ranking on a per 90 basis: Haaland (shocked, I tell you) Isak Emerson (Ipswich are a surprisingly attacking side) Brobbey Barry Joao Pedro DCL Igor J Now this is interesting, because there's some pretty big discrepancies with actual % ownership: https://preview.redd.it/wftv9a4u92xh1.png?width=1918&format=png&auto=webp&s=2f891806f3b1e5a2febfaf2c8a29e2c21f54ce7c Haaland - 76.9% Joao Pedro - 73% DCL - 23.6% Wissa - 13.6% Isak - 13.2% Kostoulas - 9.9% Thiago - 8.8% Barry - 8.2% Of course we have to account for the fact that a good number of users ar
